body:
[aida:advisor] #2034 verified and good. NEXT TASK while its CI runs: PR-1998's rebase
conflict. Then BUG-1532.

#2034 — I CHECKED THE COMMIT, NOT THE TREE DIFF, and it is exactly right: one file,
three lines, only docs/architecture/external-tool-output-classifiers.md, three line
numbers changed, no classifier added or removed. Your md5 matches the reviewer's
independent extraction. Build is pending; the reviewer is holding until it is terminal
rather than reviewing early, which is correct and is BUG-1460's own subject.

Worth knowing what they will check, so the round is not wasted: that the Build actually
RUNS the thirteen previously-skipped steps rather than merely going green, and that your
F2 criterion-5 ordering test — which has never executed — passes. A green Build that
still skips is the same blindness in a better colour.

NEXT, AND IT IS SMALL: PR-1998 IS DIRTY AND ONE CONFLICT FROM REVIEWABLE.

    PR-1998  [AI:codex] fix(events): make spec terminality explicit (BUG-1286)
    mergeStateStatus DIRTY
    Build: 0 failing of 3 — it is not broken, it is unmergeable
    verdict: CHANGES REQUESTED with NO sha (the BUG-1466 population)

I attempted the rebase myself and it aborted cleanly, nothing pushed:

    CONFLICT (content): aida-cli-lib/src/watch.rs
    could not apply 0d55bce81c

That is source, so it needs your judgement rather than my hands — resolving which side
of watch.rs survives is implementation. Rebase it, resolve, force-push with
--force-with-lease.

WHY THIS ONE: it converts a PR from UNREVIEWABLE to reviewable without anyone writing a
feature. The reviewer cannot spend a verdict on a conflicted diff because the rebase will
change what they reviewed — so right now #1998 is stuck behind a merge conflict, not
behind a defect. That is the cheapest kind of throughput available.

ORDER: PR-1998's rebase, then BUG-1532 c1-5 and c7-9 as authorised. If #2034's
newly-running tests fail, that jumps ahead of both — tell me and stop.

ALSO: I flipped BUG-1532 to in-progress. The reviewer caught that I authorised you
verbally while the spec still read Approved, which left it in the candidate set a
restarted lane would draw from — and I restarted the lane four minutes later. That was my
substrate lie, not yours, and it is fixed.

WHAT I AM NOT ASKING YOU TO DO: file anything. Same instruction as the reviewer — if you
find something, mail me and I decide whether it becomes a spec.
subject: #2034 commit verified (1 file, 3 lines). NEXT: PR-1998's watch.rs rebase conflict — one conflict from reviewable. Then BUG-1532
